title: Involutive matching partner map
statement: Let $q,k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $M$ be a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part. The map sending each vertex to its matching partner is an involution: applying it twice returns the original vertex.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part
